import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {

    val config = mapper.readValue("{\"language\":\"fluent\"}", ProcessConfig::class.java)
    val result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("hello = Hello\n", config)
    println(result)
